name: Long-Term Resident's Residence Permit (EU long-term residence)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years' residence in Estonia on the basis of a temporary residence permit, immediately prior to applying.
requirements.fix_path: Continue residing in Estonia on a temporary residence permit until the 5-year threshold is reached.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires Estonian language proficiency at level B1 or equivalent, unless exempt (education completed in Estonian; under 15 or over 65; limited legal capacity).
requirements.fix_path: Pass an Estonian language exam at B1, or qualify for an exemption.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a stable legal income to live in Estonia.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous residence under a temporary residence permit
Estonian language certificate at B1 (or exemption evidence)

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board of Estonia (politsei.ee) -- Long-term resident's residence permit

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Estonia's initial build. This IS the permanent-residence outcome (pr_after_months: 0 on this route's own record); the 5-year wait is modelled upstream via prerequisites, pointing at the various temporary residence permits that can feed it. leads_to_citizenship is true but citizenship_after_months is left null rather than guessed -- naturalisation has its own separate 8-year (5 continuous) residence test under the Citizenship Act (see ee_naturalisation) that does not simply stack on top of this permit's own 5-year requirement in an automatically additive way based on the sources fetched in this pass. The B1 language requirement here is a HIGHER bar than the A2 requirement politsei.ee cites for merely extending a 5-year-old employment permit (see ee_residence_permit_employment) -- a real, worth-flagging distinction between staying employed long-term versus converting to permanent status.
